A ballet named "The Black Snow Swan" is becoming the center of attention. Yet, strange sounds of conversation drift through The Korolevskiy Theater's walls...

#### Go to the Korolevskiy Theater

#### Go to the Korolevskiy Theater

**Paimon:** Ooh, see that poster over there? Looks like the Korolevskiy Troupe is putting on a new ballet!

**Paimon:** "Black Snow Swan"...? Huh. That's an interesting name. Aren't Snow Swans usually white?

**Paimon:** Looks like the person playing the lead is...

**Vodyanitsa:** Please come to your senses, Miss Odette. There's no way you can get all this done in time.

**Paimon:** That's Vodyanitsa's voice, isn't it? Sounds like it came from over there.

**Vodyanitsa:** The premiere is only two weeks away. Why are you still taking on Fatui missions? What about the rehearsals or the meet-and-greets here at the theater?

**Odette:** I doubt either of those will take up the whole day, and even if they do, there's still time at night.

**Vodyanitsa:** You mean when you're supposed to be eating dinner or sleeping? Which one are you planning to skip this time?

**Odette:** Neither. I made this decision based on objective knowledge of my own abilities, not—

**Paimon:** Oh, um, sorry! We didn't mean to eavesdrop. It's just, things sounded a little heated over here, so we came to check.

**Vodyanitsa:** Traveler and Paimon! Perfect timing! Help me talk some sense into Odette, please.

- **Traveler:** What's going on?

**Odette:** Nothing.

**Vodyanitsa:** Uh huh, right. Just our prima ballerina running herself into the ground again! You saw the poster outside, right? Odette's starring in the "Black Snow Swan" in two weeks.

**Vodyanitsa:** And let me tell you, this ballet is a real test of a dancer's technical skill and their emotional understanding of the character.

**Vodyanitsa:** But just as rehearsal time's getting tight, Odette's gone and accepted a monster-slaying mission from the Fatui.

**Vodyanitsa:** Who knows how long that's gonna take? It's not like monster-hunting is a walk in the park either! What if this causes problems during the final performance, and people start sending complaints to the Theater?

**Paimon:** Huh, could you explain the situation to the Fatui, maybe? Just say you didn't know how tight the rehearsal schedule was gonna get.

**Odette:** You misunderstand. I applied to work with the Fatui with full knowledge of said schedule.

**Paimon:** Huh!? Why would you do that?

**Odette:** ...

- **Traveler:** (Doesn't seem like she really wants to talk about it...)

**Odette:** All that matters is that I'm confident I can do both.

**Vodyanitsa:** *sigh*... Forget it. You win. But if someone comes looking for you, and you're nowhere to be found... I'm not covering for you this time.

- **Traveler:** Since Odette's mind is made up...

##### Response branch 2

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Yeah, we know you're just looking out for her, Vodyanitsa, but it seems like she's got her heart set on doing both...

**Vodyanitsa:** I knew it was a lost cause... Just do me a favor and at least let someone else help manage your schedule, okay, Odette?

**Odette:** I can do that on my—

**Vodyanitsa:** What was that?

**Odette:** ...Alright.

**Odette:** ...

- **Traveler:** (She's staring at me...)

##### Response branch 2

##### Shared continuation

**Odette:** Very well.

**Paimon:** That was quick!

**Odette:** We already know he's trustworthy from back when we were trapped in the Theater. / We already know she's trustworthy from back when we were trapped in the Theater.

**Odette:** Besides, he's dealt with many Harbingers and is familiar with how the Fatui operate. I'm sure he's up to the task. / Besides, she's dealt with many Harbingers and is familiar with how the Fatui operate. I'm sure she's up to the task.

**Vodyanitsa:** Hmph...

- **Traveler:** (Now Vodyanitsa is staring at me...?)

**Vodyanitsa:** You picked Traveler when I'm standing right here? We've known each other for way longer!

**Odette:** That's true, and whether it's through the Theater or the Rokot you know I'm always happy to work with you.

**Odette:** But if I left this up to you, you'd set aside too much time for rest... or drag me out to go shopping and buy snacks.

**Vodyanitsa:** Well, that's because rest is a necessity.

**Odette:** To you, everything is a "necessity."

**Vodyanitsa:** Well, there are too many fun things worth trying in this world! I'm not just gonna let them pass me by!

**Odette:** Are there? I never noticed.

**Vodyanitsa:** Hmph, of course not. You never let your eyes stray from what's right in front of you.

**Odette:** It's only natural for one's eyes to stare straight ahead.

**Vodyanitsa:** And that is why friends are so important. Each friend is like an extra pair of eyes.

**Vodyanitsa:** So, she's all yours, Traveler and Paimon! I trust your "vision," hehe.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** We've got this.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** We'll make sure the proper arrangements are made.

**Vodyanitsa:** Good. Then, since you've agreed to put Traveler in charge of your schedule, you better listen to him and follow it, Odette! / Good. Then, since you've agreed to put Traveler in charge of your schedule, you better listen to her and follow it, Odette!

**Odette:** Okay, I promise.

**Vodyanitsa:** Hmph... that's more like it. Alright, it's all up to you then. The schedule planner is over there, so fill it out whenever you're ready.

**Vodyanitsa:** Remember, the premiere for the Black Snow Swan is in two weeks.

**Odette:** The Fatui mission assessment is in one week, so do factor that in as well.

**Paimon:** Okay! Leave it to us!

**Paimon:** Wait a second... does this make us your managers for the next two weeks?

**Odette:** Hm, I suppose. Here's to the start of a successful working relationship, then.

**Odette:** The schedule planner is right over there. I'll be relying on you these next two weeks.

**Odette:** I've been so focused on the dance side of things lately that I've somewhat neglected my work with the Fatui.

**Odette:** I want to quiet my mind in these final moments before the performance and reflect on the story of the Black Snow Swan.

**Odette:** I'm confident enough in my flexibility and control, and I can use my technique to show what makes the Black Snow Swan unique...

**Odette:** But when it comes to the root cause of her inner transformation, I still feel like there's something I haven't quite figured out...

- **Traveler:** Why not give the original work another read?

**Odette:** I read it a long time ago, but...

**Odette:** At the end of the day, the author's words are just a starting point. I need to interpret the character in my own way.

**Odette:** Still, thanks to you, I've been able to talk to others and get a better understanding of the audience's vision of the character.

**Odette:** That's helped a lot. So, if nothing else, I hope my interpretation will at least meet everyone's expectations.

- **Traveler:** That's not too bad.

- **Traveler:** All the best out there.

**Odette:** Thanks. I'll see you later, then.

**Odette:** I'm looking forward to hearing your applause.

**Paimon:** Today is the day of the big performance...

**Paimon:** Time really flew by, huh. Always felt like we barely finished the last thing before the next one started.

- **Traveler:** Being a manager isn't easy...

**Paimon:** Well, the performance is about to start... How are you feeling, Odette? Confident?

**Odette:** It's not your fault. I was the one who ignored my limits and took on too many missions.

**Paimon:** Umm... Th—Then is there still time to practice now? We still have some time before the official performance, right?

**Paimon:** Right...

**Odette:** But don't worry. It's not that dire.

**Paimon:** Huh?

**Odette:** No, you served as my audience. Sometimes a performer can only see themselves clearly through the eyes of the audience.

**Odette:** Perhaps I've spent too much time in the spotlight, too much time letting other people tell me who I am. It's been a long time since I sat down and reflected on that for myself.

**Odette:** Kind of like how the black snow swan spent so long among the flock that she almost forgot the color of her own feathers.

**Paimon:** So... you think it all worked out for the best?

**Odette:** On a personal level, at least. I've decided to interpret this role in my own way.

**Odette:** Regardless of how the audience reacts... I'm going to follow my heart.

**Paimon:** Alright then. We'll be looking forward to your performance tonight!

**Odette:** Thanks. I'll look for you in the audience.

**Odette:** "I am determined to be myself, but there is a price to pay for that."

**Odette:** ...

**Odette:** Interesting. There's not one right answer to this question.

**Odette:** But in my view, I think... she found her true self.

**Paimon:** Huh, what do you mean?

**Odette:** Well, let's start with act one.

**Odette:** As the protagonist of the story, the Black Snow Swan is thrust into the spotlight. She faces fate's injustice and decides to fight it to the bitter end.

**Odette:** She works harder than anyone, proves more stubborn than anyone, and arrogantly assumes that's enough...

**Odette:** But it's impossible to see yourself clearly when the light is too bright.

**Paimon:** Huh...

**Odette:** The only way of life she knows is to "fight against" the forces that control her life.

**Odette:** She fights against her flock, against nature, against fate...

**Odette:** She sees enemies everywhere, even where there are none... never realizing that the true enemy is the uncontrollable nature of life itself.

**Odette:** So, she spends most of her time rushing from place to place, never lingering in the moment...

**Paimon:** Aw, Odette...

**Odette:** But thanks to you, through the time we've spent together and our conversations lately...

**Odette:** Not only have I been thinking about this ballet more, but I've also stopped to ask myself...

**Odette:** Why do I dance? Why am I unwilling to give up my work with the Fatui...?

**Odette:** And what I've discovered is that it all comes down to desire.

**Odette:** I crave both external validation and self-approval at the same time, and I don't just want a little, I want it all.

**Odette:** I rarely noticed it, but this desire shaped me. It drove me this far, and drives me to keep going.

**Odette:** I shouldn't exhaust myself struggling against life, just as the black snow swan shouldn't waste time trying to change the impossible. I know what I want, I know I'm capable of getting it, so I should go for it.

- **Traveler:** Well said.

**Paimon:** Yeah, that was amazing, Odette!

**Odette:** Thanks.

**Odette:** Oh, right, I wanted to share this last part with you. Here, I'll read it out.

**Odette:** "On that morning when there was no need to dance, the black snow swan quietly gazed at her reflection on the lake's surface."

**Odette:** "The clouds, reclining beside the rising sun, were so close to her. It was as if she could reach them with a single flap of her wings."

**Odette:** "If there were but one moment left in my life," thought the Black Snow Swan. "I would soar as high as I could."

**Odette:** "Reaching heights no snow swan has ever reached and daring to dream what no snow swan has ever dreamed."

- **Traveler:** That must be the desire that fuels the black snow swan...

**Odette:** Hehe, I doubt there's one right answer... But, that's how I choose to interpret it.

**Odette:** My mother would often say, ballet is about skill and technique, but it's also about feeling and expression.

**Odette:** I think, now that I've found this answer, I'll be able to perform this piece in my own way.

**Odette:** I guess you could say, my childhood dream has now come true.
